# Capture director

Capture director is an MIT-licensed local command-line tool by Derek Hanson for recording polished website demo videos. It uses YAML shot lists, Playwright, installed Google Chrome, and ffmpeg. It supports eased zooms, a synthetic cursor, scrolling, and assembly with cards, captions, and music. Default output is 1920x1080 H.264 at 30 fps.

- Source and setup: https://github.com/dhanson-wp/capture-director
- Download source: https://github.com/dhanson-wp/capture-director/archive/refs/heads/main.zip
- Requirements: macOS (tested platform), Node.js 20+, Google Chrome, ffmpeg with libx264.
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/dhanson-wp/capture-director/tree/main/skill

Recording and rendering run locally. No account or telemetry. Websites and external font or music URLs still use the network. Each shot starts with a fresh, logged-out Chrome profile. Shot lists can execute page code and read local media; review untrusted shot lists before running them.
